g.text: - Each sheet is drawn as a real circuit: parts are wired together; supply rails use power symbols; only signals that leave a sheet use

g.desc: - Each sheet is drawn as a real circuit: parts are wired together; supply rails use power symbols; only signals that leave a sheet use

g.text: global labels (flag-shaped). A few busy nodes inside a sheet use local net labels (plain text on a wire); same name = same net.

g.desc: global labels (flag-shaped). A few busy nodes inside a sheet use local net labels (plain text on a wire); same name = same net.

g.text: - Relays are split into two units: contacts (A) where they switch power, coil (B) next to its driver on 'Safety logic'.

g.desc: - Relays are split into two units: contacts (A) where they switch power, coil (B) next to its driver on 'Safety logic'.

g.text: The dual op-amps are split into halves A/B and a supply unit C; the watchdog 74HC123 into timers A/B and supply C.

g.desc: The dual op-amps are split into halves A/B and a supply unit C; the watchdog 74HC123 into timers A/B and supply C.

g.text: - References are the board's silkscreen references. RXn / CXn / DXn = part present on the board whose reference was not read.

g.desc: - References are the board's silkscreen references. RXn / CXn / DXn = part present on the board whose reference was not read.

g.text: - '?' = value not read. 'approx' / APPROXIMATE = inferred from photos or partial tracing, not confirmed by continuity.

g.desc: - '?' = value not read. 'approx' / APPROXIMATE = inferred from photos or partial tracing, not confirmed by continuity.

g.text: - Everything except the CN300 'COLD' corner is at mains potential. Off-board items (bowl heater, motor windings, motor NTC) are drawn

g.desc: - Everything except the CN300 'COLD' corner is at mains potential. Off-board items (bowl heater, motor windings, motor NTC) are drawn

g.text: in dashed frames and excluded from the BOM.

g.desc: in dashed frames and excluded from the BOM.

g.text: - The connections are identical to rev 0.1 (verified by comparing the exported netlists node by node).

g.desc: - The connections are identical to rev 0.1 (verified by comparing the exported netlists node by node).

g.text: Mains -> EMI filter -> two relays (RY200 live, RY202 neutral) -> heater (through a triac and current transformer T700) and the motor DC bus

g.desc: Mains -> EMI filter -> two relays (RY200 live, RY202 neutral) -> heater (through a triac and current transformer T700) and the motor DC bus

g.text: (a voltage doubler giving ~340 V DC, pre-charged through R115/R114 and then bypassed by RY201). A 78K0 MCU on this board drives a 4-phase

g.desc: (a voltage doubler giving ~340 V DC, pre-charged through R115/R114 and then bypassed by RY201). A 78K0 MCU on this board drives a 4-phase

g.text: switched-reluctance motor (6 IGBTs, shared high-side switches) and talks to the front panel over an opto-isolated UART (CN300).

g.desc: switched-reluctance motor (6 IGBTs, shared high-side switches) and talks to the front panel over an opto-isolated UART (CN300).

g.text: Hardware safety: both mains relays and the IGBT gate-drive supply need (a) two open-drain MCU permits that only IC700's fault comparators can hold

g.desc: Hardware safety: both mains relays and the IGBT gate-drive supply need (a) two open-drain MCU permits that only IC700's fault comparators can hold

g.text: high, (b) a running 74HC123 watchdog fed by MCU pulses, and (c) for RY202, the front panel's enable through PC503. A comparator (IC610) cuts the
